jobs.occupation: Senior Cost and Value Engineer (w/m/d) for Value Management in Product and Software Business (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Is it your passion to optimize value across portfolios, systems and products within a global Cost and Value Engineering function? Then join our team as a Senior Cost and Value Engineer for Value Management and Value Engineering (f/m/d) and actively drive sustainable value optimizations in a cross-functional environment at Siemens AG.
What we offer you

- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth - 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Appealing Siemens pension benefits

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by

- Leading and supporting Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) projects within Siemens AG with a focus on Value Management and Value Engineering:- You are responsible for leading value optimization projects in CVE (e.g., Value Benchmarking), in close collaboration with cross-functional teams to systematically improve the value of portfolios, systems and products.- You act as an expert for value improvement and interdependencies in ecosystems, portfolios and systems, and support our businesses in strategic projects.- You contribute your expertise in hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems to maximize business value holistically, considering customer requirements, technical feasibility and economic impacts.
- Consistent further development of Value Management and Value Engineering methods in Cost and Value Engineering:- You continuously further develop methods in Value Management and Value Engineering and ensure their consistent integration with existing CVE methods (e.g., Value Analysis, Requirements Engineering, CVE Benchmarking).- You develop Value Management methods to make interdependencies across ecosystems, portfolios, systems and products, as well as their lifecycle business impact, transparent.- You develop quantitative value approaches to evaluate and optimize hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems.- You further develop and maintain an AI-based Value Management knowledge base for the CVE community.
- Partner for Portfolio and Product Management and the CVE community:- You act as partner for Portfolio and Product Management functions within Siemens AG to identify and initiate CVE projects.- You promote value-driven thinking across Cost and Value Engineering and relevant business functions.- You are part of the CVE community as expert for Value Management and Value Engineering methods.

Your success is grounded in

- Education: A university degree with a technical or software-related background, e.g., industrial engineering, engineering, computer science or related fields.- Experience & Skills:- You have many years of professional experience in portfolio management, product management, value management or in comparable functions such as sales, business development or business-centric system architect.- You have a sound understanding of Value Management and/or Value Engineering, such as Value Analysis or similar approaches.- You have practical experience in optimizing systems and products, ideally in building technologies, electrical engineering or energy distribution.- You have a solid understanding of AI applications and how Value Management knowledge can be made accessible through AI-based solutions.- Ideally, you have already gained initial experience working with Cost and Value Engineering and/or Procurement Engineers.
- Ways of working:- You have strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills and can quickly understand complex structures and interdependencies.- You bring a strategic and customer-centric mindset and can translate complex business challenges into sustainable value creation opportunities.- You manage projects and time effectively, facilitate workshops professionally, and support acquisition activities with confidence.- Knowledge of Siemens products and systems in Smart Infrastructure is an advantage.- Willingness to occasionally travel, approx. 20%.
- Languages: You have excellent German and English skills, both written and spoken.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
Every day at Siemens, thousands of processes take place involving the ordering, processing, storage, and delivery of a wide variety of materials, raw materials, and products. Our Supply Chain experts keep a close eye on every movement from A to B. How can our digital processes help us operate more efficiently, effectively, and adaptively? What challenges and opportunities do we see in shaping a sustainable future worldwide? Join us in finding the answers to these questions!
www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.
FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/)  – if you need further information on the application process.

The Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science (Max Planck Gesellschaft, MPG) is a self-governing scientific organization funded by the Federal and State Governments. It conducts basic research in the fields of natural sciences, the humanities and the social sciences in 85 institutes and research units in Germany and abroad.

The MPG consists of three sections: the Biology and Medicine Section, the Chemistry, Physics and Technology Section and the Human Sciences Section. Each section has a Scientific Scouting Officer who supports the respective section and its institutes in identifying the next generation of leading researchers.

For the Human Sciences Section, the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG are now seeking a:

Scientific Scouting Officer (all genders) –

80% part‑time initially, with a potential full‑time transition effective 1 January 2029

(Reference Number 63/26)

to start as early as possible.

The Section includes a range of disciplines, notably the History of Art, Anthropology, Demography, Economics, the History of Science, Law, Neurosciences, Political Sciences, Psychology, and Sociology.

Your responsibilities

- Proactive and systematic identification of outstanding scientists to support the Human Sciences Section and its Core and Appointment Commissions
- Building and analyzing candidate pools, generating appropriate statistics
- Using various talent acquisition tools, including but not limited to internet sourcing, data mining, social media, networking at national and international conferences, as well as other creative methods to identify outstanding candidates
- Analyzing candidate lists generated through nomination calls
- Implementing, maintaining and further developing candidate databases together with the two Scouting Officers of the other section
- Attending international conferences, participating in public outreach to promote the MPG
- Complementing the current scouting team and actively participating in constantly developing the team’s scouting concept, tackling human sciences-oriented as well as interdisciplinary scouting projects

Your profile

- Doctoral degree in one of the scientific disciplines of the Human Sciences Section and several years of postdoctoral experience
- Education and/or postdoctoral research abroad, ideally for several years
- In-depth knowledge of the German and international research landscape (including organizational and research-specific framework conditions)
- Proven scientific track record and demonstrated knowledge of the respective scientific community
- General interest in a broad range of scientific subjects covered in the Human Sciences Section and ability to quickly familiarize yourself with new areas of research
- Solution-oriented, service-driven, creative and open-minded working style
- Excellent proficiency in English (written and spoken, level C1–C2) and good proficiency in German (minimum level B2)
- Excellent interpersonal communication and networking skills, in order to interact with and coordinate partners with diverse professional and multicultural backgrounds
- Experience in working with AI applications or a willingness to learn how to use such systems
- Willingness to adopt flexible working hours, as well as taking part in regular business travel in Germany and abroad
- Experience in scouting/​recruiting scientists would be desirable

Our offer

- You will gain fascinating insights into the outstanding research at our Max Planck Institutes.
- You will help to identify the next generation of outstanding scientists for the MPG by directly interacting with its leadership and directors.
- As a member of the Section Office, you will cooperate with the department "Institutes" at the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG.
- You will obtain an excellent overview of the entire spectrum of scientific administration and the structure of the German research landscape.

We are offering a payment up to salary level 14 of the collective wage agreement for the civil service (TVöD Bund) as well as various benefits.
This position is permanent and 80% part-time initially, with a potential full-time transition effective 1 January 2029. You will be based at the Administrative Headquarters of the MPG, located in the centre of Munich.

We offer a supportive work environment with flexible schedules, remote work options, and work-life balance. We invest in your professional growth through personalized development opportunities, health promotion programmes, and a company pension plan. Additional benefits include discounted public transportation passes and full access to standard public sector social benefits.

The Max Planck Society has set a goal of employing more people with severe disabilities. Applications from people with severe disabilities are expressly encouraged. The Max Planck Society is committed to gender equality and diversity. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Have we piqued your interest?

If you are interested, please send your complete online application (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130734)  **(Reference Number 63/26)**, including a personalized cover letter, to our human resources department, indicating your possible starting date. We look forward to getting to know you.

Application deadline: 2 October 2026

jobs.occupation: Principal Scientist / Senior Principal Scientist (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- Your primary responsibilities will include coordinating, evaluating, and conducting in silico assessments to predict mutagenicity in accordance with ICH M7, including the scientific evaluation of related literature searches.
- In close collaboration with i internal and external stakeholders, you will develop and support derisking strategies for mutagenic impurities and metabolites across different stages of project development.
- Furthermore, you will prepare scientific reports, including expert judgment on the relevance of findings, and contribute to regulatory submission documents.
- As a subject matter expert, you will advise Research & Development teams on mutagenic impurities, mutagenic metabolites, and acceptable exposure limits for mutagenic carcinogens.
- In addition, you will represent scientific results and recommendations in international project teams, discuss their implications, and support informed risk-based decision-making.
- You will also independently manage and respond to health authority inquiries related to ICH M7 topics, coordinate global project requirements, and ensure compliance with regulatory expectations and internal procedures.

Additional tasks for the Senior Principal Scientist-Role

- With regard to the global genotoxicity strategy, you will take a leading role in its implementation and further development to ensure the application of avoidance principles and scientifically sound risk assessments.
- Moreover, you will lead complex and time-critical issues with significant regulatory impact and provide recommendations to international stakeholders.
- Additionally, you will contribute to scientific committees and expert forums, foster scientific exchange, and drive the advancement of scientific standards and best practices.

Requirements

- PhD in Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry Eor comparable scientific degree with relevant professional experience, or Master's degree in Biology or Computer Science
- Solid knowledge of mutagenicity, structural reactivity, and genetic toxicology
- Expertise in in silico mutagenicity prediction, including relevant software tools, derisking strategies, and associated genetic toxicology assays
- Experience in literature research and the use of scientific databases
- Knowledge of pharmaceutical development and the application of genetic toxicology principles in a drug development environment
- Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, work effectively under pressure, and communicate complex scientific findings in German and English

Additional requirements for the Senior Principal Scientist-Role

- Extensive experience in applying and interpreting in silico mutagenicity assessments within pharmaceutical development
- Demonstrated capability to lead complex scientific topics and coordinate cross-functional global stakeholders
- Experience in representing scientific positions in interactions with health authorities, scientific committees, or expert forums

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

site in Europe. We are looking for a committed and experienced: Supply
& Operations Planning Manager (m/w/d) Your Key Responsibilities in
detail: Lead S&OP Planning for a Defined Product Portfolio or
Production Site Own the end-to-end S&OP planning cycle for your

fertilizer production, customer service, production stability,
logistics constraints, working capital and financial performance

evaluating business opportunities, optimizing contribution margins,
prioritizing markets and ensuring the optimal deployment of
constrained production capacities Facilitate commercial
decision-making in close collaboration with the Commercial Lead

forecasts, evaluate commercial opportunities, identify supply gaps or
surpluses and align production capabilities with Sales Managers and
the Commercial Lead Allocation & prioritization: Define & adjust
product allocations and market priorities (planned product volume/
price-positions) in close collaboration with Sales and Supply Chain
Execution to establish delivery commitments and operational priorities
Support working capital optimization by incorporating Order-to-Cash

Monitoring Tracking regional inventory targets to balance service
levels, production stability and capital efficiency Monitor the

Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial

experience in Supply Chain Planning would be an advantage Strong

trade-offs and drive decisions Structured, proactive and hands-on

stakeholder management skills High IT affinity; strong Excel skills;
experience with S&OP planning tools is a plus Fluent English (written

independently and on your own responsibility? Entrepreneurial thinking
and acting is a matter of course for you? Then we should get to know
each other! Please send your detailed CV in English to Human
Resources, attention Andreas Wagner Andreas.Wagner@eurochem.group

collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and

partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. Tasks Information Management &
Architecture Design, implement, and continuously improve the

records management processes. Ensure compliant, audit-ready
information storage and governance. Design and optimize automated
workflows, approvals, electronic signatures, and lifecycle processes.

information management and digital workplace solutions within IT
Operations. Promote best practices for collaboration, document
management, and knowledge sharing. Evaluate and implement enhancements
that improve governance and usability. Deliver training, user
documentation, onboarding materials, and guidance for Microsoft 365,
SharePoint, DMS platforms, and emerging technologies such as Copilot.
Vendor Management & Security Manage implementation partners,
consultants, and external service providers. Ensure solution quality,
governance, security, and alignment with business objectives. Oversee
implementations, enhancements, and ongoing solution performance.
Ensure compliance with IT security standards, ISO 27001, and
information governance requirements. Collaborate with security, legal,
and compliance teams to mitigate information risks and embed privacy
and security by design. Profile Strong experience in designing
information architectures and document management solutions, including
structured storage, collaboration, and lifecycle concepts. · Hands-on
expertise in Microsoft 365, particularly SharePoint, with familiarity
in modern tools such as Copilot Studio or comparable platforms. ·
Solid understanding of data structures, metadata models, and access
management concepts, with the ability to design scalable and
user-friendly solutions. · Experience in establishing governance
frameworks and applying "compliance-by-design” principles within
systems and processes. · Good understanding of system integrations
and application landscapes, including how to connect information
management solutions with business systems (e.g. ERP, databases, SaaS
tools). · Proven ability to design and implement automated workflows
and digital processes, improving efficiency and standardisation. ·
Experience in driving user adoption and delivering
training/enablement, ensuring effective and consistent usage of
systems across the organisation. · Experience in working with
external vendors or implementation partners, ensuring quality delivery
and alignment with requirements. · Awareness of information security,
data protection, and risk mitigation practices, and ability to

skills, with the ability to act as the central coordination point
between business stakeholders and external IT providers for
information management and governance activities. Additional

About us JUNA is on a mission to #electrifyroadfreight. Founded in
2023, we’ve had a strong start and have already deployed a
significant fleet of heavy-duty electric trucks in Europe. Our
innovative business model makes it easy and low-risk for carriers to
shift to electric logistics by offering electric trucks as a service,
a flexible pay-per-kilometer pricing structure, and access to
guaranteed utilization from large shippers. As a joint venture between
industry leaders Scania and sennder, JUNA gives customers access to
premium electric trucks and reliable revenue through access to
priority green freight. Your mission As JUNA’s (Senior) Finance
Manager, you will own the full reporting cycle across our European
entities — ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of
financial information as we scale. You’ll work closely with external
accounting partners in multiple countries and oversee monthly
shareholder reporting. Take ownership & drive the month-end closing
process by preparing and reviewing key accounting information and
collaborating closely with external accountants to finalize the
monthly financial records. Prepare monthly accruals. Support in
preparing monthly shareholder reporting (e.g. OPEX, Vehicle P&L).
Manage communications with external accounting offices in Italy,
Netherlands, Poland, Belgium, France, and Spain. Assist external
accountants with preparation of annual reports and third-party audits.
Prepare & issue client invoices, track payment status and proactively
follow up on overdue payments. Continuously improve, streamline and
automate finance processes to drive scalability of the finance
function. What That Looks Like In the first 3–6 months: Ramp Up
Quickly: Become fully onboarded into JUNA’s finance systems and
tools, building a solid understanding of our entity structure and
reporting flows. Own Core Processes: Independently complete your first
solo month-end close accurately and on time. Build Key Relationships:
Establish reliable, trust-based working relationships with our
external accounting offices across Europe. After 12 months: Seamless
Collaboration: Work in sync with external accounting teams across all
JUNA entities, ensuring smooth coordination and minimal friction.
Trusted Owner: Be recognized as a proactive, reliable owner of the
full reporting cycle and balance sheet — the go-to person for
financial accuracy and compliance. Process Champion: Have identified
and implemented improvements to finance workflows, contributing
meaningfully to JUNA’s operational scalability. Your profile What
you bring: Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field,
coupled with 7+ years of professional experience in a relevant role.
Comfort working with external accounting partners across multiple
jurisdictions. Proficiency with accounting software and ERP systems;
experience with consolidation tools is a plus. Professional fluency in
English required; German at B2 level or above. Who you are: Sharp and
detail-oriented — you catch errors before they become problems and
take pride in numerical accuracy. Proactive and structured — you
manage your workload independently and flag issues early rather than
waiting to be asked. Reliable under deadlines — you understand that
close cycles have hard stops and you plan accordingly. Analytical
mindset — you don’t just process numbers, you understand what they
mean and can explain variances clearly. Collaborative spirit — you
work well with external partners and internal stakeholders across
different countries and functions. Bonus points if you have:
Experience with multi-entity set-up. Exposure to scaling finance
functions in a startup or fast-growth environment. Familiarity with
IFRS in addition to HGB. Experience with MOSS, Zoho Books and Atlar.
Why us? Leadership and Innovation: Work with a pioneering team
dedicated to transforming road logistics and contributing to a
sustainable future. Autonomy and Impact: We value innovation and give
you the freedom to grow in our team to make a significant impact.
Sustainability: Join a company where your work directly contributes to
reducing carbon emissions in logistics. Benefits : Join a great team
in our dog-friendly, hybrid work model with an office located at the
heart of Kreuzberg, where you’ll enjoy a relaxed, no-micromanagement
culture, regular company events, access to Urban Sports Club and L&D
budget, and an office stocked with snacks and drinks to keep you
energized. Our Company Values Think outside the truck: challenge the
internal-only status quo, prototype fast. Impact, not activity: cut
through noise, prioritize what actually matters. Own it: end-to-end
roadmap ownership, no safety net. Collaboration drives the core: daily
work with engineers, CEO, and CTO. Customer in the driver's seat:
internal or external, understand what they need. --- At JUNA, we value
authenticity, humility, and potential — so even if you don’t check
every box, we encourage you to apply. We know that diverse
backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences are what drive true
innovation. Our team is collaborative, international, and always
evolving. Come as you are — we’re excited to meet you and
hopefully welcome you on our journey to transform the logistics
industry across Europe. If you require accommodation during the hiring
process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to
mikaela.roennkvist@juna.com. Please only contact this email for
accommodation purposes.

Company Description About EIT RawMaterials As the world moves towards
a greener future, the demand for raw materials—minerals and
metals—is set to increase immensely over the next three decades.
Europe faces a critical challenge in securing a stable supply of these
essential resources. This challenge is where EIT RawMaterials steps
in. EIT RawMaterials is at the forefront of driving innovation and
sustainability in the raw materials sector. As an Innovation Community
within the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), we
collaborate with over 300 partners across industry, academia, and
research institutes. Together, we forge dynamic, long-term
partnerships to develop innovative solutions that meet Europe's
growing demand for raw materials. The Role We are seeking a proactive,
detail-oriented and experienced Senior HR Manager (m/f/d) to join our
team in Berlin. This role will be responsible for leading key people,
compliance, and governance activities across the employee lifecycle,
ensuring that HR practices are legally compliant, operationally
effective, and aligned with organisational objectives. Acting as a
trusted advisor to managers and employees, the role provides expert
guidance on employment and employee relations matters, oversees HR
compliance and audit readiness, and drives continuous improvement of
HR policies and processes. The role also leads Health, Safety &
Environment (HSE) initiatives, ensuring compliance with German and
European regulations while promoting a safe, healthy, and engaging
workplace. Working closely with internal stakeholders, external
partners, and legal advisors, the Senior HR Manager identifies and
mitigates people-related risks, maintains strong governance
frameworks, and contributes to a positive employee experience across
the organisation. This position is ideal for an experienced HR
professional who enjoys combining hands-on operational work with
compliance oversight and strategic enhancement of HR practices. Key
Responsibilities Employment & Employee Relations Support managers on
employment-related matters and people management practices. Draft and
review employment contracts, amendments, and employment documentation.
Ensure compliance with German labor law and collective agreements
where applicable. Manage employee relations cases, including
disciplinary procedures, grievances, performance-related matters, and
workplace concerns. Partner with external legal advisors when
required. Compliance, Audits & Risk Management Conduct regular
internal HR audits to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and
company requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.
Identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions. Support
external audits and inspections related to employment, payroll, HR
processes, and workplace regulations. Monitor and communicate changes
in employment legislation and HR compliance requirements. EU Health,
Safety & Environment Lead and coordinate health and safety initiatives
in accordance with German and European regulations. Ensure compliance
with occupational health and safety requirements. Partner with
internal stakeholders and external providers to maintain safe working
environments. Coordinate risk assessments, workplace inspections, and
mandatory training. Support wellbeing initiatives that promote
employee health and engagement. Policies, Governance & Process
Improvement Review, maintain and develop HR policies, procedures, and
employee handbook content. Ensure policies are legally compliant,
practical, and consistently applied across the organization. Drive
continuous improvement initiatives across HR operations and employee
experience. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human
Resources, Business Administration, Law, Psychology, or a related
field. 5+ years of progressive HR experience in a generalist or HR
operations-focused role. Strong knowledge of German labour law,
employment regulations, and HR compliance requirements. Experience
managing payroll processes and working with payroll providers. Proven
experience conducting HR audits and implementing compliance
initiatives. Knowledge of occupational health and safety requirements
in Germany. Experience developing and maintaining HR policies and
procedures. Strong understanding of HRIS systems and HR data
management. Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.
HSE certification preferred; candidates without formal qualifications
must demonstrate a willingness to complete HSE training Preferred
Qualifications Professional HR certification or relevant HR
qualification. Experience in an international or fast-growing
organization. Previous involvement in HR transformation, process
improvement, or digitalization projects. Experience working with audit
frameworks, compliance reviews, and risk management processes. Key
Competencies Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential
information. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Ability to balance operational execution with strategic thinking.
Process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
Strong project management and organisational skills. Collaborative and
customer-focused approach. What We Offer Opportunity to shape and
improve HR operations in a dynamic environment. Collaborative and
international team culture. Professional development and learning
opportunities. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Flexible
working arrangements. A people-first workplace focused on inclusion,
wellbeing, and growth. Equal Opportunity Statement We celebrate

CHILD PSYCHOLOGIST / KINDERPSYCHOLOGE (M/W/D) – ENGLISH-SPEAKING POSITION

Kennziffer: Child Psychologist

ABOUT US:

Joy Center Family Institute is a multidisciplinary clinic specializing in child development, emotional well-being, and family support. Located in Böblingen (Stuttgart), we serve a diverse international community, including civilians families connected to the U.S. military.

We are known for our holistic, relationship-based, and play-centered therapy approach, following developmental models like DIR/FLOORTIME. Our mission is to empower children and families while nurturing growth, connection, and emotional well-being.

WE ARE CONTINUOUSLY EXPANDING OUR TEAM AND ARE CURRENTLY HIRING:

• Clinical Child Psychologists.
• Licensed Psychotherapists (able to work in Germany).
• Occupational Therapists.
• Speech and Language Therapists.

CURRENT VACANCY: Clinical Child Psychologist / Psychotherapist.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• THERAPEUTIC WORK: Provide individual and family-based psychological therapy for children aged 2-15. Focus areas often include developmental challenges, emotional regulation, behavioral concerns, social skills, and attachment-based issues.
• DEVELOPMENTAL FOCUS: Apply relationship-based, play-based models such as DIR/Floortime to foster emotional and developmental growth.
• ASSESSMENTS: Conduct psychological assessments and developmental screenings as needed.
• FAMILY SUPPORT: Engage, coach, and collaborate with parents and caregivers as part of each child's therapeutic journey.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY TEAM COLLABORATION: Participate in regular weekly supervision and team case discussions with other psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech/language therapists.
• DOCUMENTATION: Maintain accurate, timely clinical notes and assessment reports.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Degree in Psychology (Master's or Doctorate level).
• Licensed as a CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST or PSYCHOLOGICAL PSYCHOTHERAPIST with eligibility to practice in Germany (e.g., approbation or equivalent).
• Experience working with young children and families, ideally with ages 2 to 15.
• Familiarity with developmental models such as DIR/Floortime, play therapy, or other child-centered approaches (or willingness to learn).
• English fluency (our client base is international).
• Strong interpersonal skills, flexibility, and genuine passion for child development and family-centered work.

WHAT WE OFFER:

• FULL-TIME POSITION: 40 hours per week, with a balance between clinical work (28 hours) and time for documentation, supervision, and team meetings (12 hours).
• ONGOING SUPERVISION: Weekly individual and group supervision sessions plus staff meetings for professional growth and peer support.
• PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: Opportunities for continued training and workshops.
• MULTIDISCIPLINARY ENVIRONMENT: Work alongside a diverse and supportive team of psychologists, occupational therapists, and speech-language therapists.
• MEANINGFUL WORK: Directly impact the lives of children and families in a nurturing, play-based setting.

LEARN MORE:

www.joycenterfamily.com [https://www.joycenterfamily.com/]

Join our mission to help every child reach their full potential through developmentally respectful, relationship-based care. Apply now [https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=107895&tc=3-11]

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

We are looking for an IT Security Specialist to define security standards for two major data infrastructure projects in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region: (1) The Data Space Project (https://www.health-life-sciences.de/dataspace/)  of the Health + Life Science Alliance (http://www.health-life-sciences.de/) has recently been launched to develop a trusted research environment (TRE) for seven leading life sciences and biomedical research institutions in the Heidelberg-Mannheim region. (2) The German Human Genome-Phenome Archive (GHGA) (https://www.ghga.de/de/)  is part of the national program for research data infrastructures (NFDI) (https://www.nfdi.de/)  and has established a secure national omics data infrastructure, enabling the secondary use of human omics data in research.

These infrastructures are supporting the bioinformatics community with software tools for secure data/metadata storage, interactive data portals with data visualization, and streamlined data deposition and acquisition solutions. Prof. Oliver Stegle is coordinating GHGA at the DKFZ and representing the Data Space project for the DKFZ in close collaboration with the other Health + Life Science Alliance member institutions Heidelberg University, European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL), Central Institute of Mental Health, Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, Heidelberg University Hospital and University Hospital Mannheim.

In order to develop the Data Space Trusted Research Environment (TRE) and the GHGA platform into a state-of-the-art infrastructure for the secure handling and analysis of genome data, we are seeking with immediate effect an IT Security Specialist.

Job description:

We are looking for a team member with substantial experience in information security and risk governance. Your role will be instrumental in technical and organizational decision-making for the Data Space and GHGA projects and will ensure compliance with modern standards for both infrastructures. You will be part of two tightly connected teams spanning cloud engineers, data stewards and interdisciplinary researchers with the joint mission of enabling the secure sharing of sensitive biomedical data for the scientific research community. You will have a diverse set of tasks, shaping the IT infrastructure of the Data Space TRE from the start, while also managing the IT security for the operation of the established GHGA Portal and upcoming new functionalities. Your expertise will help ensure the safe operation of the Data Space TRE and GHGA while also contributing to the development of standards in Germany and supporting their role in international efforts.

Your responsibilities :

- Analysis and documentation of current operations with respect to IT security, identifying gaps and supporting continuous improvement
- Implementation and maintenance of a framework for risk and asset management, utilizing modern tools and standards
- Creation and maintenance of an Information Security Management System (ISMS)
- Implementation and maintenance of a program for security awareness that works across multiple communication channels
- Regular monitoring of risks through third-party interactors, such as used infrastructures or sub-contractors
- Provision of information security guidance for IT projects, including the evaluation and recommendation of technical controls
- Coordination of interaction with external expertise on legal and technical IT security topics

Your Profile:

Essential Expertise:

- Proven experience with core information security frameworks (BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001) and risk management methodologies
- Hands-on background in developing and implementing risk-mitigation plans, security policies, processes, and technical controls
- Solid understanding of GDPR compliance requirements and IT infrastructure fundamentals (e.g., networking, server roles, system architecture)
- Fluency in German and English to articulate technical requirements clearly and collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners
- Demonstrated project management skills, with the ability to work independently, solve problems creatively, and drive initiatives to completion

Advantageous Qualifications:

- Knowledge of cloud security guardrails in multi-account environments (e.g., IAM, SCP, centralized logging, encryption, network isolation)
- CISSP certification or equivalent advanced security credential

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!
